definitions.explanation: Any wind instrument made of metal and played by buzzing the lips into a cup-shaped mouthpiece — for example, trumpet, trombone, horn, or tuba. Contrasted with {木管楽器|もっかんがっき} (woodwind instrument).

examples.japanese: {金管楽器|きんかんがっき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{演奏|えんそう}する→演奏する：20349_ensousuru⟧。
⟦トランペット→トランペット：07541_toranpetto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{代表的|だいひょうてき}→代表的：05670_daihyouteki⟧な{金管楽器|きんかんがっき}だ。
examples.english: The trumpet is a representative brass instrument.

examples.japanese: {金管楽器|きんかんがっき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{唇|くちびる}→唇：03903_kuchibiru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{震|ふる}わせて⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: Brass instruments produce sound by vibrating the lips.

examples.japanese: ⟦{吹奏楽部|すいそうがくぶ}→吹奏楽部：27464_suisougakubu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{金管楽器|きんかんがっき}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{木管楽器|もっかんがっき}→木管楽器：25946_mokkangakki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{演奏|えんそう}する→演奏する：20349_ensousuru⟧。
examples.english: In the wind-band club, brass instruments and woodwinds play together.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{金管|きんかん}→金管：15382_kinkan⟧ (brass tube / metal pipe) and ⟦{楽器|がっき}→楽器：13159_gakki⟧ (musical instrument). Refers to the brass family of instruments, which produce sound by the player buzzing the lips into a cup-shaped mouthpiece.

Note that, as in English, the category is defined by playing technique rather than the actual material — instruments made of brass that are played with reeds (such as the saxophone) are classified as ⟦{木管楽器|もっかんがっき}→木管楽器：25946_mokkangakki⟧, not {金管楽器|きんかんがっき}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {金管楽器|きんかんがっき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吹|ふ}く→吹く：02445_fuku⟧: to play a brass instrument
- ⟦{金管|きんかん}→金管：15382_kinkan⟧⟦パート→パート：03106_paato⟧: the brass section (of a band or orchestra)
- ⟦{金管|きんかん}→金管：15382_kinkan⟧{五重奏|ごじゅうそう}: a brass quintet
- {金管楽器|きんかんがっき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{響|ひび}き→響き：00098_hibiki⟧: the sound of brass

MEMBERS OF THE FAMILY:
- ⟦トランペット→トランペット：07541_toranpetto⟧: trumpet
- ⟦トロンボーン→トロンボーン：08139_toronboon⟧: trombone
- ⟦ホルン→ホルン：23742_horun⟧ / フレンチ⟦ホルン→ホルン：23742_horun⟧: (French) horn
- チューバ: tuba
- ユーフォニアム: euphonium

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{木管楽器|もっかんがっき}→木管楽器：25946_mokkangakki⟧: woodwind instrument — the contrasting category (flute, clarinet, oboe, saxophone)
- ⟦{打楽器|だがっき}→打楽器：07532_dagakki⟧: percussion instrument
- ⟦{弦楽器|げんがっき}→弦楽器：07534_gengakki⟧: string instrument
- ⟦{管楽器|かんがっき}→管楽器：07533_kangakki⟧: wind instrument (covers both brass and woodwind)
